item.title: Morocco's Top Court Strikes Down Parts of Its New Adoul Law
item.description: Gazette issue 7520: the Constitutional Court rules on the adoul law, an online platform for debt-enforcement payments, 18 foreign degrees recognized, and a national biodiversity warning.

item.title: EU's Carbon Border Tax Kicks In — Morocco's Fertilizer Exports First in the Crosshairs
item.description: The EU’s carbon border tax is now live and Morocco’s fertilizer exports are exposed first; plus a €100M French water loan, 17,000 km² leased for offshore oil exploration, and a state bank still unable to close its books after 13 years.
